01 / OUR APPROACH+

There’s more to research
than the final result.

Behind every discovery is a trail of hypotheses, experiments, dead ends, and decisions. The paper tells you what worked. The trajectory tells you how a scientist thinks.

We partner with university research labs to capture that process, including the intuition, reasoning, communication, and judgment that usually go unrecorded.

[ 01 ]

Capture the trajectory.

Work with researchers to document how ideas take shape, experiments unfold, and directions change.

[ 02 ]

Make the challenge real.

Turn those trajectories into challenging training and evaluation tasks rooted in real scientific work.

[ 03 ]

Develop scientific judgment.

Help models ask better questions, choose promising directions, and navigate open-ended problems.
